releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.181: Note Lock PIN prompts are larger, bold and raised for readability. Note Lock verification and recovery logic, saved data and app identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 269: Note Backup now reads My Documents and My Memories files one at a time, shows progress and handles file-read errors instead of getting stuck. Combined Notes, Documents and Memories backup and restore remain supported.
